task: Issue #766: explicit OpenBao leaf validity and renewed certificate uptake without a server restart.

events.summary: Round 2 plan: remove rejected same-UID sidecar, shareProcessNamespace and extra volume; synchronize in-container watcher across bootstrap and GitOps; retain bootstrap Certificate ownership and 8760h/720h. Fix external verifier, R390, runbook, lesson and trace; run lint/validate/test then commit locally without push. No live cluster, RBAC, seal/storage configuration or image changes.

Reviewer/orchestrator measured (not repeated here): shared-PID same-UID sidecar could read bao environ and proc/root including TLS key, raft and SA token; PID 1 is wrapper shell, dumb-init PID 11, bao server PID 12. HUP of actual bao server on 2.5.4 served renewed serial, Sealed=false, restarts=0. Repository reproduction: both values contained rejected sidecar; verifier exec targeted its absent future OpenSSL. Read pinned 0.28.3 args helper and StatefulSet source: shell wrapper appends extraArgs verbatim. Reviewer exact Helm render succeeded; current sandbox Helm fetch fails DNS. Earlier DNS claim applies only to that sandbox, not chart compatibility.

D-BAO-HUP: extraArgs backgrounds the unchanged docker-entrypoint bao server command, saves its PID, starts an independent watcher subshell and waits for server exit status. Watcher initializes mounted certificate hash then hashes every 30s; changed hash sends one HUP to comm=bao and argv[1]=server, explicitly excluding PID 1. Hash advances only after successful signal; missing PID/denied signal logs ERROR and retries next tick. No extra container, image, volume, shared PID or postStart. Folded scalar keeps extraArgs a single logical line because the pinned helper does not indent inserted newlines; a literal multiline value would break rendered YAML. Watcher failure cannot terminate server. D-BAO-WINDOW: external host OpenSSL through bounded Pod port-forward; seven attempts tolerate transient API/connect errors and fail closed on persistent errors, empty output or mismatch. Runbook covers OnDelete initial and future image/chart delete+unseal.
